$comment: VAA work index. The grid on VAA_Index.html and every case-studies.html page are both rendered from this file — add, reorder or retitle a project here and both follow. 'challenge' and 'result' ship as placeholder copy written per practice; replace them per project.

works.title: Outdoor Identity
works.challenge: The category buys the same media in the same places and says roughly the same thing. Outspending it was not an option, so the work had to earn its attention on the frame itself — read in three seconds, from a moving car, at any hour.
works.result: A single idea, extended across every format the plan called for without diluting on the way down. It reads at distance, holds at close range, and the production kit means the next burst costs a fraction of the first.

works.title: Compensation Platform
works.challenge: The product did the job it was built for, but the interface asked people to understand how it worked before they could use it. Sign-ups were fine; second sessions were not. The brief was to make the first ten minutes explain themselves.
works.result: An interface built on a design system rather than a set of screens, so the patterns hold as the product grows. Fewer steps to the first useful moment, and a front-end the team can extend without redrawing it.

works.title: Product Campaign
works.challenge: The brand was recognisable to the people already inside it and to almost nobody else. Every touchpoint had been made in isolation, so the same name arrived in a different voice depending on where you met it. We were asked to find the through-line and make it hold.
works.result: One identity system, documented well enough that it survives contact with everyone who has to use it — internal teams, printers, fabricators and agencies alike. The brand now looks like itself in every room it walks into.
